title: Evaluation of Abdominal Wall Thickness at Possible Trocar Sites Based on Body Mass Index
brief_summary: The purpose of this research study is to determine which sites are best suited for laparoscopic entry of bariatric trocars in the morbidly obese population.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients between the age of 18-64; BMI greater than 18.5

Exclusion Criteria:

* Abdominal hernias
